transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today or what has been on your mind that made you come in?

I guess... it's about flying. Just the thought of getting on an airplane right now... it scares me really bad. I know it doesn't make sense. I know that. But... my body just tells me the plane is going to fall. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Is this fear of flying something that happens only in specific situations, or does it seem to be part of a more general sense of anxiety or worry in your life?
No, it's... just the flying. I don't really worry about other things. Just that.
Does this fear of flying happen every time you think about or need to get on a plane, or are there times when you can be on a plane or think about flying without feeling this fear?

Yeah... every time. 

Even if I just get an email about covering a rural shift that requires a flight... it hits me right away. My heart starts pounding. My hands get sweaty. I just... I feel like I can't breathe until I close the message. So... no, there aren't times without it.
Have you been avoiding situations where you might have to fly, like turning down assignments or events, because of this fear?

Yeah, I... I avoid it. 

I've had to cancel covering some clinics. Missed a few medical meetings. I even... I keep putting off going to see my family back in Honduras. 

I just can't do it. If I absolutely have to go to an airport, I... I'm shaking the whole time. I basically have to hold onto someone just to get through it. So mostly, I just don't go.
How long has this fear of flying been affecting you in this way? Has it been for more than six months?

Yeah... it's been more than six months. 

About seven months, I think. It started after... I lost my clinic job and had to take this small plane. It was really turbulent. Since then... yeah. Seven months.
Have you ever had these intense physical symptoms — like your heart pounding, trouble breathing, or feeling shaky — in situations other than thinking about or being on a plane?
No... just with the planes. I don't really get like that any other time. Just... when it has to do with flying.
When you think about flying, do you feel like your fear is excessive or unreasonable, and has this fear significantly interfered with your work or personal life?

Yeah... I know it's probably too much. The fear, I mean. 

It's just... it's really getting in the way. Like I said, I've had to turn down covering those clinics, which... it means I'm losing out on money. And I think the other doctors are starting to wonder if they can even count on me anymore. 

Plus, missing those meetings... and my family. I just... I haven't been able to go see them. So, yeah. It's messing things up.
